How our dry bar works

You buy the booze,
we do the rest.

Element Bar Service operates as a dry bar service, meaning you purchase the alcohol for your event directly. We help you determine what to buy and estimate quantities based on your guest count, event length, and selected drink menu, then provide the professional bartending experience at your event.

inspired by the elements.

Fire, air, water, and earth—four signature cocktails that bring the elements directly into the glass.

Hints of basil paired with the bold earthy flavors of gin.

About the Owners

Element Bar Service started as a dream shared by siblings Carlos and Viviana.

“We’ve always been close, and after spending many years working in hospitality, we realized how much we both loved creating great experiences for people. Starting Element was our chance to turn that shared passion into something of our own. We’re excited to have taken the leap together and to bring the same energy, care, and hospitality we’ve always valued to every event we serve.”
